windows.notes:
Fixes for backups and pairing. Updating is recommended.
- Two files whose names differ only in capital letters (IMG_1.JPG and img_1.jpg) each keep their own copy in a backup to Windows, a Mac, a share or a USB drive; before, one could replace the other. Names Windows can't hold are kept too, and restores give every file its own name back.
- Backups to a Windows computer refuse names Windows keeps for devices (such as "nul"), which lost the file.
- A backup to a computer no longer misses a write the computer refused.
- Deleting old backups on a share never follows a link out of the backup folder.
- A share that reports a wrong file size can no longer crash the app.
- The phone keeps a computer's new network address only once it has proven to be that computer.
- Names from the other side are cleaned up and kept short, and a pairing attempt that fails badly no longer blocks pairing.
